verdict.rationale: Asana has vendor-documented AI Teammates/AI Studio and 'Asana Dash' framed as an AI Chief of Staff that can be delegated coordination-heavy work with shared memory and governance, directly supporting task delegation to a built-in assistant. However, this is entirely first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration or detail on how delegation actually works in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of AI Teammates/Dash functioning as claimed, concrete usage examples, and community confirmation of reliability.
